procedure: cargo test --locked --workspace; equity tests for 90-percent issuance and dilution, sub-90 rejection, treasury-excluded dividend conservation, funded IPO with float/fee/history, and treasury buyback paying external holders while conserving issued shares.
limitations: Buybacks move shares to treasury rather than cancelling the issue; treasury shares carry no votes or dividends. IPO pricing uses the current fair mark, not a book-built range.
